This is p8105 homework 2

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

## Problem 1

Read and clean data, select retain line, station, name, station latitude / longitude, routes served, entry, vending, entrance type, and ADA compliance. Convert the entry variable from character (YES vs NO) to a logical variable.

So I need to remove the exit_only column.
```{r}
subway_data = 
  read_csv("./NYC_Transit_Subway_Entrance_And_Exit_Data.csv") %>% 
  janitor::clean_names() %>% 
  select(line:vending, - exit_only, ada) %>% 
  mutate(entry = ifelse(entry == "YES", TRUE, FALSE))
```
